title: Astro Fun World
specs: 7 attractions including go-karts, laser tag, mini golf, ropes course, zip line, laser maze, arcade games
Toddler play zone for ages 4 and under
Laser maze challenge for ages 5 to 10
Ropes Course & Zip Line: must be 48" tall, max weight 300 lb
Go Karts: must be 52" tall to ride alone, max weight 300 lb
Kids Ropes Course (MI): must be less than 48" tall, max weight 300 lb
Climbing Walls: any height, max weight 300 lb
Laser Tag: most children over age 8 fit vests, check vest size before playing
Party rooms fit 50 to 150 people depending on room size; charge only for guests going on attractions

blurb: Guests experience attractions including go-karts, laser tag, mini golf, ropes course, zip line, laser maze, arcade games, and toddler play zones. The venue offers private party rooms with packages including food, arcade credits, and attraction access. Special events like teen creator takeovers are also hosted.
extraNote: Party rescheduling not allowed less than 7 days in advance; cancellation less than 7 days results in full charge and $150 rescheduling fee · Non-refundable $150 deposit required for all parties, credited to final bill · Cards for attractions and credits expire August 31, 2026; old cards not accepted after June 1, 2026 · By buying tickets, guests agree to terms and conditions including waiver of liability · Party room setup allowed 15 minutes before start; pack up allowed 5 minutes after end time; late fees apply
